Oracle Fusion 26D release dates and cohorts

Cohort months for Oracle Fusion Cloud 26D, with links to Oracle's schedule. Day-level dates are not printed here, because Oracle has not published them on a public calendar we could recheck.

In short: Oracle Fusion Cloud 26D is the fourth 2026 quarterly update. Oracle publishes which months each cohort updates, and that test environments update on the first Friday of that month and production on the third Friday. Oracle has not published a public list of those Fridays for 26D, so this page does not calculate or print them. Use Oracle's links below and confirm your environment in the Oracle Cloud Console. On the content side, Oracle's 26D What's New lists 789 features across the modules we cover: 182 on by default, 130 on by default with potential setup, 86 opt-in, and 23 former opt-ins that are now standard with 26D (9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup).

Oracle's schedule: Oracle Fusion Insider, "Quarterly updates made easy" (10 Dec 2025). That article states the cohort months and the first-Friday / third-Friday rule. It does not list calendar dates for 26D. Per-environment dates are in the Oracle Cloud Success Navigator Release Planning page (sign-in) and in the Oracle Cloud Console. Middle East regions update on the Thursday before each Friday.

Cohorts and where 26D falls

CohortUpdate months Oracle publishesWhere 26D falls in that list
Cohort AFebruary, May, August, NovemberNovember
Cohort BMarch, June, September, DecemberDecember
Cohort CApril, July, October, JanuaryJanuary, after the November and December updates

Oracle names 26A, 26B, 26C and 26D as the four 2026 releases, in that order, and lists four months for each cohort. The third column is that order applied to 26D. It is not a dated Oracle calendar, and this page does not calculate the Friday inside the month.

Inside the month, Oracle's rule is: test environments on the first Friday, production on the third Friday, two weeks later. Middle East regions use the Thursday before. If that Friday is a holiday, confirm the date Oracle assigned to your environment.

Frequently asked questions

When does Oracle Fusion 26D update my environments?

It depends on your cohort. Oracle's published rule puts test environments on the first Friday of the cohort's update month and production on the third Friday. For 26D, the fourth 2026 release, those months are November (Cohort A), December (Cohort B) and the following January (Cohort C). Oracle has not published the Fridays themselves on a public calendar, so confirm your dates in the Oracle Cloud Console. Source: Oracle Fusion Insider.

Which months are Cohorts A, B and C?

Per Oracle Fusion Insider: Cohort A is February, May, August and November; Cohort B is March, June, September and December; Cohort C is April, July, October and January.

Why does this page not list a Friday for 26D?

We rechecked Oracle's quarterly-updates article and the public readiness site. They state the cohort months and the Friday rule. They do not list a dated 26D calendar. Calculated Fridays would be unverified, so they are not on this page. Your dates are in the Oracle Cloud Console and in Release Planning.

What should I do in the two-week test window?

Start with the 26D what-to-test checklist, review features on by default and opt-ins, and decide which of the 23 former opt-ins now standard need setup. See also Prepare for a quarterly update.
